results.question: What is the capital of France?

results.question: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
results.response: The characters in Romeo and Juliet were written by William Shakespeare, an English playwright and poet. The play is considered one of the greatest tragedy of all time and one of the most important works of literature in the English language. The story is set in the late 1590s and tells the story of Romeo (a young man) and Juliet (a girl) who fall in love and are killed by a plague, and their families who suffer the consequences. The play is renowned for its rich portrayal of love, corruption, and betrayal, and it remains one of the most iconic and loved plays of all time.

results.question: Summarize the theory of relativity in simple terms.
results.response: Relativity is a theory that suggests that the laws of physics are the same for all observers, regardless of their relative motion or speed. This means that at any given moment, all observers in the same reference frame will see the same phenomena, even if they are moving at different speeds.
